metadata.description: AI bro is a set of ten skills covering the full agent workflow — onboarding, thinking, specification, planning, spec and plan review, implementation, code review, closing the work, and adaptable project knowledge. File-based specification and planning call /bro-review-spec-plan once, then close those findings without a second independent review. It adapts to your realities without imposing methodology. Includes a critical model tier for mandatory security reviews.
